title: Effect of parent-child relationship.
bodyText: Except as otherwise provided in section 560:2-125(b) through (e), if a parent-child relationship exists or is established under this subpart, the parent shall be deemed a parent of the child, and the child shall be deemed a child of the parent, for the purpose of intestate succession.
bodyHtml: [§560:2-122]  Effect of parent-child relationship.  Except as otherwise provided in section 560:2-125(b) through (e), if a parent-child relationship exists or is established under this subpart, the parent shall be deemed a parent of the child, and the child shall be deemed a child of the parent, for the purpose of intestate succession. [L 2023, c 158, pt of §2]
